book.name: Matai
book.title: Uruunu ambaiŋana ki Yesu Krisi ta Matai ibeede

content: Sua tooroŋana pa bobi ki Anutu
To Yesu ikam sua tooroŋan pakan mini pizin tomtom. Iso:
“Peeze ki kar saamba na, ka mbulu kembei ta king ta. Ni isombe ikam kini pa ula ki lutuunu.
Tana ikam sua ila pizin wal pakan pa ula tabe ipet i. Mi iparaŋraŋ koroŋ ta boozomen makiŋ, to iŋgo mbesooŋo kini mini ma tila be tiyo zin leembe. Tamen tila na, zin leembe mburan be timar som.
Tana iŋgo mbesooŋo pakan mini, mi iso pizin ma iso: ‘Zin wal ta aŋboobo zin be timar na, kala mi koso pizin ta kembei: ‘Kini ma buzur, ta aŋparaŋraŋ pataaŋa kek. Tana kamar mi takan ula ka kini.’
Tamen zin leembe tikam ŋgar pa bobi tana som. Mi tila pa uraata kizin kizin. Pakan tila pa mokleene, mi pakan tila be tikam ŋgomo pa koroŋ kizin.
Mi pakan na, tikiskis zin mbesooŋo ki king, mi tikam bakai pizin, mi tipun zin ma timetmeete.
“Tabe tipas king tana keteene ma keteene malmal kat. To iŋgo zin malmal kan kini ma tila, mi tikas zin wal ta tipun mbesooŋo kini na ma timetmeete lup, mi titun kar kizin.

Kaimer to, iboobo mbesooŋo kini pakan ma timar, mi iso pizin ta kembei. Iso: ‘Aiss, lutuŋ kini kini ula kana ta aŋparaŋraŋ makiŋ kek. Mi zin wal ta muŋgu aŋboobo zin be timar na, aŋur motoŋ pizin sorok. Aŋdemeere ma aŋso ko zin wal ambaimbaiŋan. Mi iŋgi som.
Kena kala mini, mi kapa pa zaala lwonlwon mi koso pizin wal ta boozomen be timar ma tikan kini ki lutuŋ. Pa iŋgi koroŋ isu ma isaana kek.’
“Tana zin mbesooŋo tila pa zaala lwonlwon mi tiyo wal ta boozomen ma timar ma ruumu tana bok kat. Tikam zin wal ambaimbaiŋan, mi wal sananŋan tomini.
“Tikanan ma timbotmbot, to king ilela be ire zin leembe. Mi ire tomtom ta, ni iur mburu ki ula som mi imar sorok.
Tana iwi i ma iso: ‘Ndaŋ, parei ta nu ur mburu ki ula som, mi mar le ti sorok?’ Mi tomtom tina, ni le sua sa som.
To king iso pizin mbesooŋo kini ma iso: ‘Kopo kumbuunu ma namaana, mi kipiri i pera zugut lene. Lele tana ka tomtom bizin tiyakyak mi zoŋon ŋekŋek ma timbotmbot.’”
To Yesu iparwai sua kini ma iso: “Bobi ki Anutu ila pizin iwal biibi. Mi tamen ka tataŋa men, ta ni ikam zin.”
Wiŋana pa takes piriŋana
To zin tutu kan tila tilup zin mi tiru zaala pa Yesu. Tisombe titoombi pa wiŋana pakan. Beso ni ipekel ŋoobo, to iwe le uunu.

Tana tiŋgo naŋgaŋ kizin pakan ziŋan Erot wal kini pakan ma tila ki Yesu, mi kwon imbeeze pini ma tiso: “Mos katuunu, niam amute: Nu tomtom ki sua ŋonoono men. Nu mototo zin tomtom som, mi lae ki tomtom sa som. Nu zzo katkat zin tomtom pa Anutu zaala kini, mi kamam sua ŋonoono men pizin.
Tana so kat piam. Nu re be parei? Iti sombe tigiibi takes ila ki Kaisa, ko indeeŋe pa tutu kiti, som som?”
Mi Yesu, ni iute ŋgar kizin sananŋana kek. Tana iso pizin ma iso: “Niom pakamkaamŋoyom! Parei ta koso kotoombo yo?
Pat ta tiwirri pa takes na, kakam tasa imar ma aŋre.” Tana tikam pat denari ta ila kini.
Mi ni iteege, to iwi zin. Iso: “Lak, asiŋ ruŋguunu mi zaana ti?”
Zin tiso: “Ina Kaisa tau.” To Yesu iso: “Tana. Koroŋ ta Kaisa zaana pa, to ila kini. Mi koroŋ ki Anutu na, ila ki Anutu.”
Tileŋ sua kini tana na, timurur pa. To tizemi mi tila len.
Wal meeteŋan ko timaŋga mini, som som?
Indeeŋe aigule tana na, zin sadusi pakan tomini timar ki Yesu. Zin sadusi na, Yuda pakan ta tiurla kembei Anutu ko irao ipei zin meeteŋan ma timaŋga mini som.

Tana timar ki Yesu, mi tiwi i ma tiso: “Mos katuunu, Mose iso ta kembei: Sombe tomtom sa iwoolo moori ma tipeebe sa som mi imeete, to tiziini bela iwoolo ka nooro. Beso tipeebe ma iŋgi, tona pikin tana ikel toono kolmanŋana ta imeete na.
Lak, lwoono ta na, toŋmatiziŋ tiam lamata mi ru. Timbotmbot ma muŋgamuŋga iwoolo. Mi ikam kelŋana sa som, mi imeete. To tiziini ta ito i na, ikam ka nooro.
Mi tipeebe sa som, mi ni tomini ra, imeete. To tiziini ta iwe tel pa na, ikam mbulu raraate men. Ta kembei kembei ma zin lamata mi ru tana timetmeete lup. Mi len kelŋan sa som.
To kaimer na, moori tomini, ni imeete.
Lak, indeeŋe mbeŋ kaimer ma zin meeteŋan tisombe timaŋga mini pa naala, nako moori tina iwe tomtom iŋgoi kusiini? Pa zin lamata mi ru ta tiwooli na.”
Yesu ipekel kwon ma iso: “Aiss, niom tina, kuute Anutu mburaana mi sua kini risa som kat. Tanata kakam kat ŋgar som.
Mbeŋ kaimer, sombe Anutu ipei zin meeteŋan ma timaŋga mini pa naala, na tomtom ko tiparwoolo zin mini som. Pa zin ko kembei zin aŋela ta timbot saamba a.
Mi maŋgaŋana kizin wal meeteŋan, ina niom katalli pa kat. Parei, sua ta Anutu ikam piom na, kapaata som? Sua ta iso ta kembei:

content.text: Nio iŋgi Anutu ki Abaraam, Isak, mi Yakop.

content: “Sua tana iswe kembei wal tel tana matan yaryaara ma timbotmbot raama Anutu. Mibe timeete ma tila len kat, so ni irao ipaata itunu be Anutu kizin som.”
Zin iwal biibi tileŋ sua kini tina na, timurur pa mi sua imap.
Tutu mataana kana
Zin tutu kan tileŋ kembei Yesu ipiri sua pizin sadusi ma sua kizin imap, to tila tilup zin.
To tomtom kizin ta, tau ni le ŋgar biibi pa tutu na, ni isombe itoombo Yesu.
Tana ila ipet ki Yesu, mi iwi i. Iso: “Mos katuunu, tutu iŋgoi ta ilip pa tutu ta boozomen?”
Yesu ipekel kwoono ma iso:

content.text: “Ur lelem ila ki Merere Anutu ku raama ŋgar ku mi mburom ma imap ma iwe ni lene men.

content: “Tutu tiŋgi ta biibi kat mi iwe mataana pa tutu ta boozomen.
Mi tutu biibi toro ta ka ŋgar igarau, ina ta kembei:

content.text: Ur lelem pizin tomtom kembei ta lelem pa itum.
“Tutu ta boozomen ki Mose mi sua ta muŋgu Anutu kwoono bizin tiso na, timap ma timbot lela tutu ru taiŋgi lelen.”

content: Mesia ko iyooto pa Dabit be parei?
Zin tutu kan tilup zin ma timbotmbot, mi Yesu iwi zin ma iso:
“Lak, Mesia tabe imar i, niom kakam ŋgar pini be parei? Ko ipet pa asiŋ popoŋana kini?” Mi zin tiso: “Ni ko ipet pa Dabit.”
To Yesu iwi zin mini ma iso: “Kena parei ta Bubuŋana ipei ŋgar ki Dabit ma ipaata Mesia be Biibi kini?
Pa Dabit iso ka sua ta kembei:

content.text: Merere Anutu iso pa Biibi tio ta kembei:
‘Mar mbulem su ta nomoŋ woono i
ma irao aŋkoto kom koi bizin ma mburan imap kat,

content: “Tana Dabit itunu ipaata Mesia be Biibi kini. Lak, popoŋana sa ki Dabit ko irao be ilip pini be parei?”
Tileŋ sua kini tana ma sua imap. Tomtom sa irao be ipekel kwoono som. Tana indeeŋe tana mi ila na, tomtom sa iwi i pa kosa sa mini som. Pa timoto.
